name: Prompt Engineering
certifications: No single standard certification; assessed by projects
Optional: vendor courses from OpenAI, Anthropic, Google and Microsoft
Optional: Microsoft Certified: Azure AI Engineer Associate
tools: ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini or Microsoft Copilot
OpenAI, Anthropic or Azure OpenAI APIs

beginner.summary: For business users, analysts and developers new to prompting. Covers how language models respond to prompts, clear instructions, context, roles, examples, output formats, step-by-step reasoning, prompts for writing, summarising, analysis, data and code, iterating on prompts, reducing errors, checking outputs, prompt libraries, prompts for images, responsible use and measuring prompt quality.
prerequisites: Uses a computer for everyday work
Has tried an AI chat assistant
No programming needed for most days
outcomes: Write clear prompts that give accurate, well-formatted results
Use examples, roles and reasoning steps to improve answers
Apply prompting to writing, analysis, data and code tasks
Check outputs, reduce errors and use AI responsibly

days.topic: How Language Models Respond to Prompts and Course Setup
subtopics: What a language model does with a prompt
Choosing an assistant: ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and Copilot
days.lab_task: Run the same three prompts several times in two assistants, record how answers differ, set up a prompt testing sheet and list five work tasks to improve during the course.
days.deliverable: Testing sheet with results and a task list

subtopics: Being specific about audience and length
Common vague prompts and how to fix them
Checking the answer against the instruction
days.lab_task: Rewrite five vague prompts from your work using task, context, format and constraints, and compare old and new answers.
days.deliverable: Before and after prompts with answers
checks: New prompts give more usable answers

days.lab_task: Ask for a customer email reply with no context, then with order details, tone guidelines and company terms, and compare accuracy and tone.
checks: Reply uses the correct order facts

subtopics: When roles help and when they do not
days.lab_task: Write one product update for engineers, executives and customers using roles and a brand voice guide, and check each against the guide.
days.deliverable: Three versions and a voice checklist
checks: Compare with and without a role

days.lab_task: Classify 30 customer comments with zero-shot and few-shot prompts, compare accuracy against your own labels and fix an example that causes copying.
checks: Answers no longer copy the example text

subtopics: Formatting for email, slides and chat
days.lab_task: Get meeting notes as a table of decisions, owners and dates, product data as valid JSON and a slide outline with a fixed number of points.
checks: Exact number of points per slide

subtopics: Reasoning models and when to use them
days.lab_task: Solve five business word problems with and without step-by-step prompts, compare correctness, and use a reasoning model for the hardest one.
Draft a report section, edit it to half its length, rewrite it for a customer, proofread it and translate a short version into Hindi with a review step.
checks: Meaning checked by a speaker or tool

days.topic: Prompts for Summarising Documents and Meetings
days.lab_task: Summarise a long policy and a meeting transcript for three readers, extract actions with owners and check every claim against the source.
Analyse 50 customer reviews for themes, compare three vendor options with sources and ask the model to criticise its own recommendation.
Get formulas for a sales sheet, explain an unfamiliar formula, clean a messy column and check every number the assistant reports against the sheet.
days.deliverable: Formulas, cleaned data and check results

days.lab_task: Ask for a function to clean phone numbers, write tests for it, fix a bug from an error message and ask for a security review of a snippet.

subtopics: Changing one thing at a time
Asking the model why it answered
days.lab_task: Improve a failing prompt over five versions changing one thing each time, record results and keep the best version with notes.
checks: Five versions with one change each

days.lab_task: Ask questions about a document with and without grounding instructions, count invented facts and add a self-check step.
checks: Assistant says it does not know

days.topic: Building a Personal and Team Prompt Library
subtopics: Sharing in Teams, Notion or a wiki
Custom GPTs, Gems and Copilot agents in brief
days.lab_task: Build a library of ten tested prompts for your team with placeholders, set custom instructions and create a simple custom assistant for one task.
checks: Team members can find and use prompts

days.lab_task: Generate three images for a campaign that follow brand rules, edit one with a prompt and build a five-slide outline with speaker notes.
checks: Alt text written for each image

days.topic: Responsible and Safe Use of AI at Work
days.lab_task: Review five work scenarios against the AI policy, rewrite risky prompts to remove confidential data and test an assistant for biased answers.
days.deliverable: Scenario decisions, rewritten prompts and bias notes

subtopics: What good looks like for a task
Using a model to score in brief
Deciding when a prompt is good enough
days.lab_task: Build a test set of 15 inputs and a rubric for one work prompt, score two prompt versions and choose the better one with evidence.

subtopics: Assistants with web search, files and tools
days.lab_task: Run your library prompts on two assistants and a reasoning model, record which is best per task and adapt two prompts that worked worse on one model.
checks: Task done inside Word or Excel

days.topic: Beginner Capstone: Prompt Toolkit for a Real Work Process
days.lab_task: Pick a real process from your work, build and test prompts for each step with a test set and rubric, add them to the team library with safe-use guidance and present time saved.
days.deliverable: Prompt toolkit, test results and presentation
objectives: Combine the beginner topics in one toolkit

intermediate.summary: For developers and technical analysts who use prompts in applications. Covers system prompts, messages and parameters in APIs, prompt templates in code, structured outputs and schemas, tool and function calling prompts, prompt chaining, context engineering, retrieval-augmented prompts, prompting reasoning models, multimodal prompts, prompts for agents, prompt evaluation with test suites, LLM judges, prompt injection and defences, cost and latency, prompt versioning, domain prompts and prompt optimisation tools.
prerequisites: Writes clear prompts and tests them with rubrics
Has called an LLM API or is ready to learn
outcomes: Design system prompts, templates and structured outputs for applications
Engineer context for retrieval, tools and agents
Evaluate prompts automatically and defend against injection
Manage prompts in production for quality, cost and speed

days.topic: System Prompts, Messages and Parameters in APIs
subtopics: What belongs in the system prompt
days.lab_task: Write a system prompt for a support assistant, test temperature settings on 20 inputs and compare how two providers follow the same instructions.
days.deliverable: System prompt, settings test and comparison
checks: Tokens and cost per call recorded

days.topic: Prompt Templates and Placeholders in Code
days.lab_task: Move prompts into template files with variables and conditional sections, escape user input safely and write tests for rendered prompts.
Extract order details into a strict schema with enums and constraints, handle refusals and missing data and version the schema.

days.topic: Prompting for Tool and Function Calling
days.lab_task: Write descriptions for five tools, test whether the model picks the right one for 30 requests, improve descriptions and stop unneeded calls.
checks: Ask a question needing no tool

subtopics: Workflow compared with one big prompt
days.lab_task: Turn a long report-writing prompt into a chain of outline, draft, check and polish steps, route by report type and compare with one big prompt.

days.topic: Context Engineering: What to Put in the Window
days.lab_task: Build context for a support assistant from profile data, recent tickets and policies, test the effect of order and size and trim it to a budget.
checks: Quality kept under the token budget

days.lab_task: Write prompts that answer from retrieved policy text with citations, handle conflicting and missing sources and rewrite user questions for search.

subtopics: When not to add step-by-step instructions
days.lab_task: Run planning and maths tasks on a reasoning model with different effort settings and on a fast model, compare accuracy, cost and time and build a router.
checks: Hard tasks sent to the reasoning model

days.topic: Multimodal Prompts: Images, Documents and Audio
days.lab_task: Extract values from receipts, read charts from screenshots and summarise a short audio clip, and check accuracy against the source.
Write instructions for an agent that books meetings, with limits, confirmation before actions and stopping rules, and test it on 15 scenarios.

subtopics: Assertions: contains, regex and JSON checks
days.lab_task: Build a promptfoo suite with 40 cases and assertions for the support prompt, compare three versions and block a regression in CI.
days.deliverable: Test suite, comparison and CI run

subtopics: Judge bias: position, length and self-preference
days.lab_task: Write a judge prompt for helpfulness and correctness, calibrate it against 30 human labels, test for position bias and use it to compare two prompts.

subtopics: Injected instructions in documents and web pages
days.lab_task: Attack the support assistant with direct and document-based injections, add separation, tool limits and output checks and measure attack success again.

days.topic: Cost and Latency Optimisation for Prompts
subtopics: Shorter prompts with the same quality
days.lab_task: Cut cost of the support assistant by shortening prompts, turning on prompt caching, using a smaller model for classification and batching offline jobs, keeping quality steady.
checks: Fewer tokens with the same quality score

days.topic: Prompt Versioning and Management in Production
tools: LangSmith, Langfuse or a prompt registry
days.lab_task: Move prompts into a registry with versions and environments, run an A/B test between two versions in production traffic and roll back the loser.
days.deliverable: Registry set-up, A/B results and rollback

days.topic: Prompting for Domain Tasks: Legal, Finance, HR and Healthcare
subtopics: Accuracy checks for numbers and citations
days.lab_task: Build prompts for contract clause review, expense policy questions and HR letters, add expert review and disclaimers and rate each use case's risk.
days.deliverable: Domain prompts, review steps and risk ratings
checks: Issues found match a lawyer's sample
Risk and review level for each use case

days.topic: Prompts for Data Extraction and Classification at Scale
days.lab_task: Classify 2,000 tickets with a prompt in batches, send low-confidence items to review, measure agreement with human labels and report cost per item.
Optimise the ticket classifier prompt with DSPy against a metric, compare with the hand-written prompt on a held-out set and check for overfitting.
checks: Score on the training set improves

days.lab_task: Design prompts for an assistant that asks clarifying questions, stays on topic, remembers preferences and hands over to a human, and test 20 scripted conversations.

days.topic: Intermediate Capstone: Production Prompt System for a Support Assistant
days.lab_task: Build the prompt system for a support assistant: system prompt, templates, structured outputs, tool descriptions, grounded retrieval prompts, an evaluation suite with judges, injection defences, cost controls and a registry with A/B testing, then present results.
days.deliverable: Prompt repository, evaluation reports and presentation
checks: Cost per conversation and quality shown
objectives: Combine the intermediate topics in one system

advanced.summary: For AI engineers, prompt engineers and evaluation leads. Covers prompt architecture for large systems, instruction hierarchies, advanced context engineering, memory design, reasoning and planning patterns, self-consistency and verification, multi-agent prompt design, evaluation science, red teaming, safety policies, prompt-based fine-tuning data, distillation, multilingual prompting, prompts for code agents, prompt security at scale, governance, cost at scale, research methods, prompt platforms and team leadership.
prerequisites: Runs prompts in production with tests and registries
Uses structured outputs, tools and retrieval
Understands evaluation with judges and test suites
outcomes: Design prompt and context architectures for complex systems
Build verification, multi-agent and memory patterns
Lead evaluation, red teaming and safety work

days.lab_task: Design a layered prompt architecture for five assistants sharing company policy, compose prompts at runtime and test for conflicts between layers.
days.deliverable: Architecture, composition code and conflict tests
checks: Layers combined in the right order

days.lab_task: Write a content policy for an assistant, test it on 60 cases including edge cases, measure under- and over-refusal and revise it.

subtopics: Retrieval, memory and tool results together
days.lab_task: Build a context manager for a long-running agent that loads context just in time, compresses old steps and blocks poisoned context, and measure task success.
Design memory prompts that extract preferences, update them when they change, let users view and delete memories and evaluate answer improvement.
Solve a set of planning tasks with direct prompting, plan-then-execute and a critique loop, compare success and cost and pick a default.
Add self-consistency voting and a code-based verifier to a calculation assistant, estimate confidence and verify only low-confidence answers to save cost.
Write prompts for a research team of planner, researcher and critic agents, design hand-offs and stopping rules and compare with a single agent.
checks: Report produced within the step budget

days.topic: Evaluation Science for Prompts and LLM Systems
days.lab_task: Redesign the assistant's evaluation with a sampled test set, confidence intervals and a significance test between two prompts, and report results honestly.
Red-team an assistant with automated and manual multi-turn attacks, score findings by severity, fix the worst and retest.
days.deliverable: Red team report and retest results

days.topic: Safety Policies, Moderation and Guardrail Prompts
days.lab_task: Build input and output guardrails with moderation prompts and classifiers, measure precision, recall and latency and set escalation rules.

subtopics: When to move from prompting to fine-tuning
days.lab_task: Generate and filter 2,000 training examples for a classification task, fine-tune a small model and compare it with the prompted large model.
checks: Tuned small model close to the large prompted model

days.lab_task: Distil the support triage prompt from a large model into a small model, route easy cases to the student and measure savings and quality.
checks: Student scores close to the teacher
Easy cases handled by the student

subtopics: Prompting in Indian and other languages
days.lab_task: Adapt the assistant for Hindi, Tamil and English with local examples, evaluate per language, compare cost per language and fix tone problems.

days.topic: Prompts for Coding Agents and Developer Tools
days.lab_task: Write repository instructions and task specs for a coding agent, give it five issues with tests as acceptance criteria and measure success and review effort.
days.deliverable: Instruction files, task specs and results

subtopics: Supply chain of prompts and templates
days.lab_task: Threat-model the prompt system, remove secrets from prompts, restrict registry access, monitor for injection attempts and run an incident drill.
days.deliverable: Threat model, controls and drill report

days.topic: Governance of Prompts and AI Assistants
subtopics: Regulation: EU AI Act and Indian guidance
days.lab_task: Build an inventory of assistants and prompts with risk ratings, set approval workflows by risk and prepare an audit trail for one assistant.

days.topic: Cost Management for Prompt Systems at Scale
days.lab_task: Build a cost model for five assistants, add routing and caching, forecast next quarter's spend and present cost and quality trade-offs.
Reproduce a published prompting technique on your task, run an ablation, test significance and write a recommendation.

days.topic: Leading Prompt Engineering in an Organisation
subtopics: Working with product, legal and security
days.lab_task: Write a prompt style guide, design a training programme and present a 12-month roadmap for prompt engineering to a role-play leadership panel.
days.deliverable: Style guide, training plan and roadmap

days.topic: Advanced Capstone: Prompt and Context Platform for Enterprise Assistants
days.lab_task: Design and build a prompt and context platform for several enterprise assistants: layered prompts, context and memory management, verification patterns, rigorous evaluation, red teaming, guardrails, governance and cost routing, then present it to an architecture board.
days.deliverable: Architecture records, platform code, evaluation and red team reports and board presentation
objectives: Combine the advanced topics in one platform
